findings.text: follow-on: the case is named for "the prompt its worker reads" but records plan.stdin_text through the launcher seam, and a fresh dispatch's worker reads <run_dir>/prompt.txt written from the raw brief at reckon/crew/dispatch.py:2125-2126, so the regression its name claims to prevent -- the naming never reaching the worker -- would leave this assertion green; the node's own retry_failures records the assertion being moved off the prompt file for exactly this reason.

follow-on: declares_image_input re-reads input_modalities, which reckon/flight.py:1953 declared_input_modalities owns for the same lane -- the new reader case-folds and splits a comma string where the owner does not -- so the eligibility that admits a lane to a figure review and the naming that delivers the figure are held by two readers that can disagree.
